meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜与关键帧渲染成片,配上语音与字幕,还能批量导出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有大量视频素材要批量渲染、配音、导出成品。
copy.tagline_en: Render clips into finished videos with voiceover, captions, and batch export
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have piles of footage to render, voice, and ship in bulk.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你做视频项目:初始化、搜索并安装现成动效、写合成、跑 lint/check 检查、预览,再渲染出 mp4,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求用 HyperFrames CLI 做视频项目(初始化、编写、渲染等),或要排查构建、渲染失败时触发。它需要 Node.js 22 及以上和 FFmpeg。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI (npx hyperframes) for video projects: init, search and install motion primitives, author compositions, run lint and check, preview, then render to mp4. It also diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build a video project with the HyperFrames CLI (init, authoring, rendering) or when diagnosing build or render failures. Requires Node.js 22 or newer and FFmpeg.
